# Each test's seconds in CI's WebAssembly diff (both sides, O0 and
# O1-paged-chain), by which wasm-emu's shards are balanced
# (run_diff_test.py --shard --costs); a test not here costs the median.
# Only their ratios matter. Written by
#   python3 tests/run_diff_test.py --emu build-wasm/emu-node --base-emu build/emu \
#     --matrix standard --only O0,O1-paged-chain --count-packets -t 120 \
#     --ignore-list .github/emu-ignore.txt --write-costs .github/wasm-diff-costs.txt
# (Node 24.19, 8 tests at once on a 20-thread x86-64 host).
